description: Corner radii and line widths in dp (Android), pt (iOS), CSS px (web). Screens use a role, never a number. Corners are continuous (squircle) where the platform makes it cheap. Lines are rare (README: no outlines); strokes lists every one allowed.

tile.use: Small tiles, such as collection tiles

screenDepth.use: The screen behind a pushed page

checkbox.use: A checkbox's box (the only use of 4)

fieldError.use: Border of a field in error, always with its message

checkbox.use: An unticked checkbox's box, in outlineStrong

focusRing.use: Keyboard focus ring on the web, in accent
